finalText:
Build now passes (exit 0). The three `WARN` lines (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, unused export, circular import) are pre-existing style/lint warnings, not the failure — they didn't need fixing to unblock the build, but flagging them if you want them cleaned up too.

**Root cause:** `src/core/settings.js:17` referenced an undefined bare variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, throwing `ReferenceError: retries is not defined` at link time. Fixed by adding a `retries` default and reading `env.retries || DEFAULTS.retries`.
